verdict.rationale: IRCC's home page links to published guidance on accounts (GCKey) and biometrics, which suggests account and identity-proofing requirements are documented somewhere public. But the evidence is only a navigation label and never shows an exact, up-front list of the account, credential and identity steps that stand before filing. missing for 10: an explicit pre-start checklist of required account, credential and identity-proofing steps, evidence that these are shown before the flow begins rather than mid-application, per-program detail (e.g., Start-up Visa), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: Accounts (GCKey, representatives, employers and more), biometrics, forms, change address
